test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Height of Rahul, Hardik, Surya, Mohan and Kamal are compared. Height of Rahul is less than only three persons. Height of Surya is neither more nor less than the height of Rahul. Height of Kamal is more than Mohan but less than Hardik. Height of how many persons is more than Surya but less than Hardik?
solution:
Given Persons: Rahul, Hardik, Surya, Mohan and Kamal.

1) Height of Rahul is less than only three persons.

2) Height of Surya is neither more nor less than the height of Rahul - This implies that the height of Surya and Rahul will be same.

__ > __ > __ > Rahul = Surya

3) Height of Kamal is more than Mohan but less than Hardik.

Hardik > Kamal > Mohan > Rahul = Surya

So, there are 2 persons height is more than Surya but less than Hardik.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
